Name: DM Music Pack No Longer maintained
Author: Darkmushu1
Description:
I'm quitting modding to explore other things in life, whoever wants to take over the project and or maintain just let me know and I can add a redirect link here to your Nexus mod page.

This is a music pack that replaces existing game music using the framework music replacement framework. This mod doesn't do anything by itself without the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41865]music replacement framework. [/url]

This mod replaces some vanilla music with some DM Music.
